same_work_units.title: Faster fixed-point quantum search from a lower bound on initial fidelity
Average-case exponential quantum-query lower bound for cloning hidden-subspace states with primal and dual membership oracles

semantic_independence_note: One average-case hidden-subspace cloning query lower bound at the exact epsilon regime. No separate amplification/helper/error threshold/worst-case count. Distinguished from untouched1539–1541 boson-sampling complexity/permanent outcomes and from cryptographic money-security variants.
